editorial:
Imagine moving to a quiet little village in Ireland for a peaceful retirement, only to find out the town is hiding a dark secret. You follow a retired detective who quickly realizes that children have been vanishing from the area for years. Since the local police aren't doing anything about it, he decides to use his old skills to solve the case himself. The vibe is very moody and mysterious, making you feel like something is always lurking just around the corner while you explore the foggy countryside.

The acting is solid and the slow build-up of tension really keeps you guessing. While the story moves a bit slowly at first, the payoff is worth the wait because the mystery actually makes sense. You might find some parts a bit too quiet, but that is just part of the charm. If you enjoy dark mysteries, you should definitely check this out. It looks great streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you love owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: You find out that the disappearances are linked to a local legend and a creepy group of people in the village. The detective discovers that the children were being taken for a sick ritual. In the final showdown, he manages to track down the remaining kids and stop the villains. He finally brings justice to the town, proving that he still has the skills of a top cop even in retirement.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves small-town mysteries and gritty detective stories.
